name: av_ad_line
description:
Chaikin accumulation/distribution line for one stock from Alpha Vantage (AD).
Returns: {"Meta Data", "Technical Analysis: Chaikin A/D"} keyed by date or timestamp, each with Chaikin A/D.
Inputs (* required): symbol* (ticker); interval (1min, 5min, 15min, 30min, 60min, daily, weekly or monthly; default daily).
Use it for buying versus selling pressure from close location and volume; av_obv. Raw prices: av_stock_daily.
Example: {"symbol": "IBM", "interval": "daily"}

interval.description: Bar interval: 1min, 5min, 15min, 30min, 60min, daily, weekly or monthly
